answer: New agents enter through a raven courier route: three couriers, each established for 20+ epochs, must carry the newcomer's crystal shard to the zenith registry, staking 1,000 POA apiece. The shard records every identity the applicant ever held, so a second application under the same shard burns all three stakes at once. Forging 1,000 fake agents needs 3,000 courier signatures at 2,000 POA each, 6,000,000 POA in total, and one caught courier loses its 20-epoch standing. Like a mountain pass where every climber's pack is weighed at the summit, climbing twice costs the whole expedition.
